## Objective

What should this change accomplish?

## Scope

What is included in this Pull Request?

## Out of scope

What must not change?

## Verification

What was checked or tested?

## Evidence

Screenshots or a short video of the change running in the app. Required for UI or behavior changes; write "N/A" otherwise.

## Guardrail

If this fixes a mistake made by an agent, link the lint rule, test, or CI check that now prevents it. Write "N/A" otherwise.

## Review

- [ ] One objective only
- [ ] No unrelated refactors
- [ ] Relevant checks completed
- [ ] Evidence attached for UI or behavior changes
- [ ] Agent mistakes fixed here are enforced by a check, not only by an instruction in AGENTS.md
- [ ] No comments added to justify workarounds
- [ ] Production was not modified directly
- [ ] Ready for human review
